description_en: Retrieves the snapshot chain for a Database File System (DBFS). A snapshot chain is a sequence that includes all snapshots associated with a DBFS instance. Each file system has exactly one snapshot chain
description_zh: 查询数据库文件系统快照链。快照链是一个数据库文件系统所有快照组成的关系链，一个文件系统对应一条快照链
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs get-snapshot-link --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --link-id sl-b3zlgraysgcs9jy00000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSnapshotLink

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
